title: Q0 Universal Runtime Qualification Campaign
description: Runs the Q0 live runtime-qualification profile through the Universal Runtime lifecycle before the real Login R00+ workload may start.
intent: Qualify the exact Universal Runtime candidate using the declared Q0 matrix, live probe, self-fix replay, broader regression, exact SHA certification, and Nhat acceptance/handoff.
outcome: A typed Q0 qualification node result with exact run/profile identity, evidence references, effect-boundary decision, and Universal typed NEXT.
constraints: Q0 is a workflow mode/profile of Universal Runtime and Node Architect, not a separate runtime or the Login workload.
Universal UR.G0..UR.G6 lifecycle semantics are not aliases for legacy GWC effect gates.
Every lifecycle advance requires gate-specific evidence and the Universal kernel transition.
Q0 certification and acceptance never grant merge, deployment, production, credentials, migration, or destructive-effect authority.
Nhat is the human Q0 acceptance decision authority; @approver may only transport/capture a decision.
exclusions: Starting Login R00+ before CAMPAIGN_READY_RUNTIME/L3, exact certified_q0_sha, and accepted handoff.
Using legacy approval-token gates as Universal Q0 lifecycle evidence.
Protected-main mutation, merge, deployment, production config/data, secrets, migration, destructive operations, force-push, or history rewrite.
entry_guards: Q0 profile digest and exact run identity are valid
effect authority is resolved separately for any concrete effect
